name: Villanueva de Argecilla (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of yellow, green and yellow, the green charged with the large crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de Argecilla (a tree and a fountain on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de Argecilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villanueva de Argecilla arms — tree and fountain on yellow
cap of the crown of the arms
